description: A GPU-accelerated library containing highly optimized building blocks and an execution engine for data processing to accelerate deep learning training and inference applications.

latest_release.name: DALI v2.4.0
latest_release.body:
Key Features and Enhancements
---
This DALI release includes the following key features and enhancements:
* Added experimental reader support for Google Cloud Storage (gs:// paths) (#6495, #6467)
* Improved arithmetic operators in dynamic mode (#6475, #6476, #6480, #6481)
* Added support for CUDA 13.4U1 (#6489, #6478)
* Added S3 support for webdataset index files (#6483)
* Add experimental support for Python 3.15 (#6461)
* Added documentation for Torchvision custom operators (#6490, #6470)
* Moved from custom DALI conda recipe to upstream nvidia-dali-feedstock (#6402, #6474)



Fixed Issues
---
* Fixed zero-extent GPU image launches (#6505)
  * Thank you @arcusbuilds for your contribution!
* Fixed silent integer overflows in arithmetic operators (#6481, #6480)
* Fixed numpy reader returning unread sample data (#6482)
* Fixed torchvision ColorJitter’s missing hue to degrees conversion (#6471)
  * Thank you @Kayvan-Zahiri for your contribution
* Fixed legacy viedo NVDEC reader using stale surface requirements (#6460)


Improvements
---
* Update VERSION to 2.4.0
* Bump packaging upper bound to 26.3 (#6523)
* Update DALI_DEPS_VERSION (#6521)
* TorchVision documentation (#6490)
* Extend static analysis for arithmetic operators (#6476)
* Add schema aliases. Use aliases in rename-only deprecations. (#6310)
* Retry install_pip_pkg with --ignore-installed after an unrecordable uninstall (#6485)
* Process workspace inputs and outputs without code duplication. (#6499)
* Update DALI_deps for gRPC cross-compilation (#6495)
* Document that random_shuffle shuffles only locally (#6491)
* Add Google Cloud Storage (gs://) reader support (#6467)
* Add S3 storage integration tests, and S3 support for webdataset index files (#6483)
* Move to CUDA 13.4 U1 (#6489)
* Deps update 09.2026 (#6477)
* Add DALI_INT64_VEC and use it in Constant (#6486)
* Update CUDA 13 Paddle package to 3.4.0 (#6488)
* Improve the sharding and shuffling documentation (#6484)
* Add CUDA 13.4 build configuration (#6478)
* Multiple crops example (#5656)
* Fix Coverity use-after-free in C API checkpointing test (#6473)
* Pull latest DALI deps hardinging (#6472)
* Update TorchVision API links in the documentation (#6470)
* Enable data analytics directly from nvidia-theme (#6469)
* Move from custom DALI conda recipe to upstream nvidia-dali-feedstock (#6402)
* Add CUDA 13 Paddle packages for Python versions (#6468)
* Skip Paddle iterator tests with ASan (#6465)
* Respect user warning filters in Python deprecation warnings (#6463)
* Fix flaky conditional merge test (#6457)
* Update DALI_DEPS_VERSION (patch libsound) (#6462)
* Add experimental support for Python 3.15 (#6461)
* Suggest a remedy when as_array hits a non-uniform tensor list (#6464)
* docs: fix minor typos in documentation (#6459)
* Add Secret scanning workflow (#6390)
* Enable copy-pr-bot for NVIDIA-hosted GitHub Actions runners (#6450)
* Warn when S3 SSL verification or plugin preload is configured (#6442)
* Disable XLA command buffers in JAX examples (#6449)
* Improve documentation for framework iterators and readers (#6435)
* Fix a dynamic mode thread-safety test (#6452)

Bug Fixes
---
* Fix schema alias test on platforms which don't have BUILD_CUFILE (#6524)
* Promote scalars to constants in ndd arithmetic operators (#6475)
* Fix zero-extent GPU image launches (#6505)
* Prevent silent integer overflows in arithmetic operators (#6481)
* Fix protobuf 36 serialization in ASAN builds (#6492)
* Fix int downcasting in dynamic mode (#6480)
* Keep NumPy 1 for Paddle 2.6 (#6487)
* Fix numpy reader returning unread sample data (#6482)
* Convert torchvision ColorJitter hue to degrees for fn.color_twist (#6471)
* Fix conda custom operator build and self-tests (#6474)
* Update Paddle examples for Paddle 3.4 (#6446)
* Prevent stale code ids in the transparent functions registry (#6458)
* Reconfigure NVDEC decoder for increased surface requirements (#6
